description: Search the record of changes (each commit message: the law, its dates, what it did) rather than the text of the law. For example "temporary", "COVID", "Bundesrat". With start and end, the changes in force from start to end, both days included.

end.description: The latest in-force date to include, YYYY-MM-DD or "today". Defaults to no end, so changes not yet in force are included.

jurisdiction.description: Optional jurisdiction: a country by its name in English or its own language ("germany", "Deutschland", "UK") or its ISO code ("de"), or a path prefix, for example "germany", "united-states/federal" or "united-kingdom/uk/legislation/uksi".

kind.description: laws (default; "law" is read the same): law only. judgments: court decisions (case law) only. all: both. A jurisdiction that names case law (a path ending in /caselaw) reads it too.

max_results.description: At most this many (default 30, at most 200).

offset.description: Rows to skip: the next_offset the answer before gave in "page" (default 0).

query.description: Words to look for in the change notes, as plain text; upper and lower case match alike.

start.description: The earliest in-force date to include, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to the start of the record.

name: search_changes
title: Search changes
